subject.title: fix(runtime): cancelled workflows no longer continue external commands

question: Should external cancellation permanently invalidate a resumed pipeline's prior resume token and approval ID after a side-effecting stage may have started?
rationale: The patch coherently prevents duplicate side effects, but it intentionally changes cancellation from retryable to fail-closed for persisted state and repository history does not document that contract.

options.title: Adopt at-most-once cancellation
options.body: Keep invalidation so partially executed resumed work cannot be replayed, after adding live proof that both the token and approval ID become unusable.

options.title: Retain cancellation retryability
options.body: Preserve the old state after abort and redesign duplicate-side-effect protection before merging.

recommendation.title: Adopt at-most-once cancellation
recommendation.body: Keep invalidation so partially executed resumed work cannot be replayed, after adding live proof that both the token and approval ID become unusable.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest available history owner for the original runtime and persisted resume-state contract.
